description: This file defines a mock class for the IGstGenericPlayerPrivate interface, used for unit testing within the Rialto media server component. It includes mock method declarations for various media pipeline operations.
external_methods: MOCK_METHOD(void, updateAudioCaps, (int32_t rate, int32_t channels, const std::shared_ptr<CodecData> &codecData), (override))
MOCK_METHOD(void, updateVideoCaps, (int32_t width, int32_t height, Fraction frameRate, const std::shared_ptr<CodecData> &codecData), (override))

classes.name: GstGenericPlayerPrivateMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IGstGenericPlayerPrivate interface for unit testing the media pipeline components.

methods.name: scheduleNeedMediaData

methods.name: scheduleEnoughData
methods.description: Schedules the event indicating enough data is available for the specified GstAppSrc source.

methods.description: Schedules handling of audio buffer underflow.

methods.name: scheduleVideoUnderflow
methods.description: Schedules handling of video buffer underflow.

methods.name: scheduleAllSourcesAttached

methods.description: Sets the rectangle area for the Westerossink element.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
